notes: The portable C++ and Java TCK scenarios exercise clause 1.5 case-sensitive federation/federate names, clause 4 application participation, and clause 4.5 federation-execution isolation with public IEEE 1516.1-2025 services. They use one ASCII case variant per name family and check exact-duplicate rejection and case-preserving reports. The Java case also checks same-execution receive-order object, attribute, interaction, and timestamped-interaction delivery controls while a peer in another execution receives no corresponding data callbacks and advances through the timestamped interval. The adapter supplies the provider, baseline FOM, logical-time selection, and endpoint. Passing locally is bounded API-level test evidence, not independent-provider validation or a claim of conformance.
